name: Original Item 9
definition: Identifies the original notification item, to which the cancellation advice refers.

OriginalItemIdentification.name: Original Item Identification
OriginalItemIdentification.definition: Identification of the original notification item.

OriginalEndToEndIdentification.name: Original End To End Identification
OriginalEndToEndIdentification.definition: Unique identification as assigned by the debtor to unambiguously identify the original underlying transaction to the creditor.

UETR.name: UETR
UETR.definition: Universally unique identifier to provide an end-to-end reference of a payment transaction.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of money expected to be credited to the account, as per the original notification to receive.

ExpectedValueDate.name: Expected Value Date
ExpectedValueDate.definition: Value date on which the account was expected to be credited.

OriginalItemReference.name: Original Item Reference
OriginalItemReference.definition: Provides further information in order to identify a previous payment notification.
